description: Complete Stage 10 frontend: AdminLayout, UserLayout, AdminDashboard, AdminGrievances, SemanticSearch, Departments, Evaluation, AuditLogs, SafeguardingPortal, SensitiveCase pages, and all frontend services. Wire everything in App.jsx. Depends on FEAT-001 (backend routes must exist for pages to compile cleanly).
steps: 1. Create frontend/src/components/layouts/AdminLayout.jsx. Props: { children }. Fixed left sidebar (w-60) on md+ screens, collapsible hamburger on small screens. Use NavLink from react-router-dom for nav items — active style 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' vs inactive 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'. Nav links: [{to:'/admin/dashboard',label:'Dashboard',icon:LayoutDashboard},{to:'/admin/grievances',label:'Grievances',icon:FileText},{to:'/admin/patterns',label:'Patterns',icon:Network},{to:'/admin/action-center',label:'Action Center',icon:Zap},{to:'/admin/outcomes',label:'Outcomes',icon:BarChart2},{to:'/admin/recurrence',label:'Recurrence Monitor',icon:Activity},{to:'/admin/search',label:'Semantic Search',icon:Search},{to:'/admin/departments',label:'Departments',icon:Building2},{to:'/admin/evaluation',label:'Evaluation',icon:LineChart},{to:'/admin/audit-logs',label:'Audit Logs',icon:Shield},{to:'/admin/upload',label:'Upload Dataset',icon:Upload}]. Top bar: app name 'Campus Guardian 360', user.fullName from useAuth(), logout button. Mobile: hamburger toggles sidebar open/close with state. Main area: flex-1 overflow-auto p-6. Import from lucide-react: LayoutDashboard, FileText, Network, Zap, BarChart2, Activity, Search, Building2, LineChart, Shield, Upload, Menu, X, LogOut. Import useAuth from context/AuthContext.

2. Create frontend/src/components/layouts/UserLayout.jsx. Props: { children }. Simple top navigation bar (sticky, bg-white, shadow-sm). Left: app name 'Campus Guardian 360'. Center nav links (NavLink): Dashboard (/user/dashboard), Submit (/user/submit-grievance), My Grievances (/user/my-grievances). Right: user.fullName + logout button. Main: pt-16 (account for fixed nav) p-6. Import useAuth. Style with Tailwind.
3. Create frontend/src/services/evaluationService.js. Export: getMetrics() calling api.get('/evaluation/metrics'), returns res.data.
4. Create frontend/src/services/searchService.js. Export: semanticSearch(query, limit=10) calling api.post('/search', { query, limit }), returns res.data.

5. Create frontend/src/services/departmentService.js. Export: getDepartments() api.get('/departments'), createDepartment(data) api.post('/departments', data), updateDepartment(id, data) api.patch('/departments/'+id, data). Return res.data for all.

6. Create frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboard.jsx. Use AdminLayout wrapper. Stat cards row (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6): fetch in parallel using Promise.all — Total Grievances and Pending (from getGrievances({limit:1}) checking total), Resolved (from getMetrics()), Active Patterns (from getPatterns({status:'active'})), Pending Actions (from getActions({approvalStatus:'Pending Approval'})), Outcomes Measured (from getOutcomes({limit:1}) total). Use existing frontend/src/services/grievanceService.js (getGrievances), frontend/src/services/patternService.js (getPatterns), frontend/src/services/actionService.js (getActions), frontend/src/services/outcomeService.js (getOutcomes), and the new evaluationService.js. Socket.IO: connect to import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL?.replace('/api','') || 'http://localhost:5000', listen for 'grievance:new' and 'grievance:statusUpdate' — on event, refetch stats. Recharts BarChart (h-64, ResponsiveContainer): grievances by category from metrics.grievances.byCategory (array from evaluationService). Recharts LineChart placeholder (h-48): weekly trend if available from metrics, otherwise show 'No trend data yet' message. Recent Grievances table: last 5 from getGrievances({limit:5, page:1}), columns: Tracking Code, Category, Severity badge, Status badge, Date. Quick links row: 4 cards linking to /admin/patterns, /admin/action-center, /admin/upload, /admin/search. Handle loading (skeleton cards with animate-pulse) and error states.

7. Create frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminGrievances.jsx. Use AdminLayout wrapper. Load grievances from getGrievances() (from existing grievanceService.js) with server-side pagination (page, limit=20). Client-side text filter on description and trackingCode. Filter dropdowns: category (16 options matching Grievance.js enum), status, severity — each as controlled select. Table columns: Tracking Code, Submitted By (submitterName or 'Anonymous'), Category, Severity badge, Status badge, AI Priority (aiMetadata.priorityRecommendation), Created (formatted date), View (button navigating to /user/grievance/:id). Export CSV button: generate CSV from current loaded grievances using browser Blob. Pagination controls: Previous/Next with page N of M display. Empty state. Loading spinner. Error alert.

8. Create frontend/src/pages/admin/SemanticSearch.jsx. Use AdminLayout wrapper. Controlled textarea for query input (min 3 chars). Submit button calls semanticSearch(query) from searchService.js. Results rendered as cards (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2): each card shows Tracking Code, Category badge, Severity badge, Status badge, description excerpt (first 200 chars), similarity score as a coloured percentage bar (0-100%). 'View Grievance' button navigates to /user/grievance/:id. Loading spinner during search. 'No results found' empty state. Error banner. Tip text: 'Describe an issue in natural language to find similar grievances.'

9. Create frontend/src/pages/admin/Departments.jsx. Use AdminLayout wrapper. Load from getDepartments() (departmentService.js). Display as cards grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3): each card shows name, code badge, head, contactEmail, description, isActive toggle (PATCH call to updateDepartment). 'Add Department' button in header opens a modal (controlled with useState showModal). Modal form fields: name (required), code, description, contactEmail, head. Submit calls createDepartment(formData) then refreshes list. 'Edit' button per card opens same modal pre-filled with department data, submit calls updateDepartment(id, formData). Close modal on success or cancel. Loading and error states.

10. Create frontend/src/pages/admin/Evaluation.jsx. Use AdminLayout wrapper. Load from getMetrics() (evaluationService.js). 'Refresh' button top-right. Sections: System Stats (4 stat cards: Total Grievances, Resolved %, Avg Resolution Time in days, Total Patterns), AI Metrics (read aiMetrics fields from API — show status strings per metric type or 'Not evaluated'), Action Stats (3 stat cards: Total/Approved/Resolved), Outcome Stats (3 stat cards: Improved/Stable/Worsened + Recurrence Detected count). Recharts PieChart (h-48) for outcome direction distribution. Recharts BarChart (h-64) for grievances by category. Loading skeleton. Error state.

11. Create frontend/src/pages/admin/AuditLogs.jsx. Use AdminLayout wrapper. Load from new GET /api/auth/audit via a simple api.get('/auth/audit', { params }) call (no separate service file needed — inline). Filters: actionType select (list common types: 'generate_action_draft','approve_action','reject_action','update_action_status','measure_outcome','check_recurrence','create_department','update_department','submit_grievance' + 'All'), startDate/endDate date inputs. Table: Timestamp (formatted), User (log.userId?.fullName || log.userId), Action Type, Resource, IP Address. Pagination (page/limit=50). Export CSV. Loading and error states.

12. Create frontend/src/pages/safeguarding/SafeguardingPortal.jsx. Route is /safeguarding/portal. Use a simple top-bar layout (no AdminLayout — sensitive officer portal has its own styling). Load sensitive grievances: api.get('/grievances', { params: { isSensitive: true, limit:20, page } }) (NOTE: the existing GET /api/grievances returns all for sensitive_officer role — confirm in getGrievances service). Stats bar: Total Sensitive, Anonymous Sensitive, Unresolved count. Table: Tracking Code, Category, Severity, Status, Anonymous flag badge, Submitted Date, 'Review Case' button navigating to /safeguarding/case/:id. Pagination. Include a note box: 'Handle all sensitive cases with appropriate confidentiality.' Use slate/red colour palette appropriate for a security-focused interface.

13. Create frontend/src/pages/safeguarding/SensitiveCase.jsx. Load grievance via api.get('/grievances/'+id) from the existing GET /api/grievances/:id. Display all grievance detail fields. If grievance.isAnonymousSensitive is true, show a 'Reveal Submitter Identity' section with a button that calls api.get('/grievances/'+id+'/identity') and displays the returned user fullName and email. Confirm dialog before revealing. Show the revealed identity in a bordered box with a warning: 'Identity revealed for investigative purposes only. This action is logged.' Status update control: dropdown of valid next statuses + PATCH call via api.patch. Notes section. Back button to /safeguarding/portal.

14. Update frontend/src/App.jsx. Remove the placeholder AdminDashboard and SafeguardingDashboard inline function components. Add imports for all new pages: AdminDashboard (from ./pages/admin/AdminDashboard), AdminGrievances (./pages/admin/AdminGrievances), SemanticSearch (./pages/admin/SemanticSearch), Departments (./pages/admin/Departments), Evaluation (./pages/admin/Evaluation), AuditLogs (./pages/admin/AuditLogs), SafeguardingPortal (./pages/safeguarding/SafeguardingPortal), SensitiveCase (./pages/safeguarding/SensitiveCase), RecurrenceMonitor (./pages/admin/RecurrenceMonitor). In /admin/* nested Routes, replace <Route path='dashboard' element={<AdminDashboard/>}/> with the imported component and add: <Route path='grievances' element={<AdminGrievances/>}/>, <Route path='outcomes' element={<Outcomes/>}/>, <Route path='recurrence' element={<RecurrenceMonitor/>}/>, <Route path='search' element={<SemanticSearch/>}/>, <Route path='departments' element={<Departments/>}/>, <Route path='evaluation' element={<Evaluation/>}/>, <Route path='audit-logs' element={<AuditLogs/>}/>. Replace the /safeguarding/* route: change from single SafeguardingDashboard component to nested Routes with: <Route path='portal' element={<SafeguardingPortal/>}/>, <Route path='case/:id' element={<SensitiveCase/>}/>, <Route path='*' element={<Navigate to='portal' replace/>}/>. Also update the requiredRoles for /safeguarding/* to include 'admin' alongside 'sensitive_officer'. Import Outcomes from ./pages/admin/Outcomes (if not already imported).
acceptance_criteria: npm run build in frontend/ completes with 0 errors after all pages are created
AdminLayout.jsx renders a sidebar with all 11 nav links and wraps children in a main content area
UserLayout.jsx renders a top navigation bar wrapping children
AdminDashboard.jsx imports and uses evaluationService, grievanceService, patternService, actionService, outcomeService
AdminGrievances.jsx has filter dropdowns, pagination, and CSV export
SemanticSearch.jsx calls searchService.semanticSearch and renders result cards with similarity bars
Departments.jsx renders department cards with edit/create modal
Evaluation.jsx renders metrics from evaluationService with Recharts charts
AuditLogs.jsx queries /auth/audit with pagination and filters
SafeguardingPortal.jsx loads sensitive grievances and links to SensitiveCase
SensitiveCase.jsx has identity reveal flow with confirmation
App.jsx has no inline placeholder AdminDashboard or SafeguardingDashboard functions; all new routes are wired
All new frontend service files (evaluationService.js, searchService.js, departmentService.js) export the expected functions
findings: 1. Created frontend/src/components/layouts/AdminLayout.jsx with fixed sidebar (11 nav links, hamburger toggle on mobile, user info + logout). 2. Created frontend/src/components/layouts/UserLayout.jsx with sticky top-bar nav. 3. Created frontend/src/services/evaluationService.js (getMetrics), searchService.js (semanticSearch), departmentService.js (getDepartments, createDepartment, updateDepartment). 4. Added getGrievances() admin export to grievanceService.js (was missing — only getMyGrievances existed). 5. Created AdminDashboard.jsx with socket.io, parallel stat fetching, BarChart, and recent grievances table. 6. Created AdminGrievances.jsx with server-side pagination, filter dropdowns, CSV export. 7. Created SemanticSearch.jsx with similarity bar and result cards. 8. Created Departments.jsx with add/edit modal and isActive toggle. 9. Created Evaluation.jsx with PieChart and BarChart from evaluationService. 10. Created AuditLogs.jsx with inline api.get('/auth/audit'), filters, pagination, CSV export. 11. Created SafeguardingPortal.jsx (dark slate/red palette, stats bar, table with 'Review Case' links). 12. Created SensitiveCase.jsx with identity reveal flow (confirm dialog), status update control, and back button. 13. Updated App.jsx: removed placeholder AdminDashboard and SafeguardingDashboard inline components; imported and wired all new pages under /admin/* and /safeguarding/* (nested Routes); added admin to safeguarding requiredRoles. 14. npm run build passed with 0 errors (only chunk-size warning and module-type note, both acceptable).
